metrics.label: IPP (5v5)
metrics.desc: Individual points percentage: the share of 5v5 goals scored with the player on ice on which he had a point.

metrics.label: Points pace
metrics.desc: Points per game times the season's games.

metrics.label: Unblocked attempts
metrics.desc: Individual Fenwick: goals, shots on goal and misses.

metrics.label: Shot attempts
metrics.desc: Individual Corsi: every attempt, blocked ones included.

metrics.label: ixG
metrics.desc: Individual expected goals, all situations (sum of the xG of the player's unblocked attempts).

metrics.label: Expected Fenwick sh%
metrics.desc: ixG per unblocked attempt: shot quality.

metrics.label: Shooting talent
metrics.desc: Shrunk finishing: goals above xG on a manned net regressed toward the league by the stabilisation constant of finishing, gax x attempts / (attempts + k).

metrics.label: High-danger attempts / 60
metrics.desc: Unblocked attempts with xG of 0.20 or more, per 60.

metrics.label: Rebound attempts / 60
metrics.desc: Attempts within 3 s of a team-mate's or own attempt.

metrics.label: Rush attempts / 60
metrics.desc: Attempts within 4 s of a neutral- or defensive-zone event.

metrics.label: Wrist / snap share
metrics.desc: Share of unblocked attempts that were wrist or snap shots.

metrics.label: Slap share
metrics.desc: Share of unblocked attempts that were slap shots.

metrics.label: Tip / deflection share
metrics.desc: Share of unblocked attempts that were tips or deflections.

metrics.label: CF / 60
metrics.desc: On-ice shot attempts for per 60 at 5v5.

metrics.label: CF%
metrics.desc: On-ice share of shot attempts at 5v5.

metrics.label: FF%
metrics.desc: On-ice share of unblocked attempts at 5v5.

metrics.label: SF / 60
metrics.desc: On-ice shots on goal for per 60.

metrics.label: SA / 60
metrics.desc: On-ice shots on goal against per 60.

metrics.label: SF%
metrics.desc: On-ice share of shots on goal.

metrics.label: On-ice sh%
metrics.desc: Team shooting % with the player on ice.

metrics.label: On-ice sv%
metrics.desc: Team save % with the player on ice.

metrics.label: On-ice G - xG
metrics.desc: On-ice goal differential minus expected goal differential.

metrics.label: CF% rel
metrics.desc: CF% on ice minus the team's CF% without him (in his games).

metrics.label: RAPM offence
metrics.desc: Regularised adjusted plus-minus: the player's isolated effect on his team's 5v5 xG for per 60 (teammates, opponents, zone starts and score controlled; ridge with multi-season priors).

metrics.label: RAPM defence
metrics.desc: Isolated effect on xG against per 60, signed so that higher is better (fewer chances allowed).

metrics.label: RAPM net
metrics.desc: Offence plus defence: isolated xG differential per 60.

metrics.label: RAPM offence SE
metrics.desc: Posterior standard error of RAPM offence.

metrics.label: RAPM defence SE
metrics.desc: Posterior standard error of RAPM defence.

metrics.label: RAPM net SE
metrics.desc: Posterior standard error of RAPM net (with the offence-defence covariance).

metrics.label: RAPM CF
metrics.desc: Isolated effect on shot attempts for per 60.

metrics.label: RAPM CA
metrics.desc: Isolated effect on shot attempts against per 60 (higher is better).

metrics.label: RAPM power play
metrics.desc: Isolated effect on PP xG for per 60.

metrics.label: RAPM penalty kill
metrics.desc: Isolated effect on PK xG against per 60 (higher is better).

metrics.label: OZ start %
metrics.desc: Offensive-zone share of the 5v5 faceoffs (O + D) taken with the player on ice.

metrics.label: DZ start share
metrics.desc: Defensive-zone share of all 5v5 on-ice faceoffs.

metrics.label: OZ faceoffs on ice
metrics.desc: 5v5 offensive-zone faceoffs with the player on ice.

metrics.label: DZ faceoffs on ice
metrics.desc: 5v5 defensive-zone faceoffs with the player on ice.

metrics.label: QoC (TOI)
metrics.desc: TOI-weighted mean 5v5 TOI per game of the opponents faced.

metrics.label: QoT (TOI)
metrics.desc: TOI-weighted mean 5v5 TOI per game of the team-mates on ice.

metrics.label: QoC (xGF%)
metrics.desc: TOI-weighted mean xGF% of the opponents faced.

metrics.label: QoT (xGF%)
metrics.desc: TOI-weighted mean xGF% of the team-mates on ice.

metrics.label: 5v5 TOI share
metrics.desc: Share of the team's 5v5 time in his games.

metrics.label: Avg shift (s)
metrics.desc: Mean shift length in seconds (stint segments joined).

metrics.label: Top speed
metrics.desc: Fastest skating burst (mph), NHL EDGE (2021-22 onward).

metrics.label: 20+ mph bursts
metrics.desc: Skating bursts of 20 mph or more.

metrics.label: OZ time %
metrics.desc: Share of 5v5 time in the offensive zone (EDGE).

metrics.label: Rink value (GAR)
metrics.desc: Goals above replacement: RAPM offence and defence at 5v5, power play, penalty kill, shooting talent, penalties and faceoffs, against a replacement-level skater.

metrics.label: Rink value (WAR)
metrics.desc: GAR in wins (goals per win from the season's scoring).

metrics.label: Projected points
metrics.desc: Rest-of-season projection: points so far plus remaining games times a points rate regressed toward the position average by the rate's stabilisation constant.

metrics.label: Projected goals
metrics.desc: Goals so far plus remaining games times a regressed goal rate.

metrics.label: Projected xGF%
metrics.desc: 5v5 xGF% regressed toward 50 % by its stabilisation constant.
